description.zh:
付费类型：
- Prepaid：预付费。
- Postpaid：后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:
- Prepaid: subscription.
- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh: 可选值，不填时查询该region下全部的组合。
description.en: The zone combination. If this parameter is not specified, all zone combinations in the region are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase describe-multi-zone-available-resource --charge-type Prepaid --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-combination cn-hangzhou-bef-aliyun --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
